title.narrative: Integrated Resilience Strengthening of Vulnerable Households in the Northwest of the Central African Republic

description.narrative: Direct target group: 30,000 vulnerable people (5,000 households), including around 9,000 internally displaced people (IDPs) (30%), 3,000 returnees (10%) and 18,000 people from host communities (60%). At least 4,000 disadvantaged young people (13%), 13,500 women (45%) and 1,500 people with disabilities (5%).The project will be carried out in partnership with four public institutions for agriculture, livestock and health (ACDA, ONASEM, ANDE, health districts), and up to four national NGOs.Indirect target group: up to 85,000 households (510,000 people, around 50% of whom are women), including community members, host families and returnees*/IDPs.

Project objective: The resilience of displaced people and host households in the Central African Republic is strengthened by improved food and nutritional security on a sustainable basis. Impact/Outcome 1: The target communities have improved their food and nutritional security.Impact/Outcome 2: Households have improved and diversified their incomes through increased local economic opportunities, support for income-generating activities and local markets.Impact/outcome3: Communities in the project area have improved their relations and strengthened good local governance.

The project aims at strengthening the resilience of IDPs and local households (30,000 vulnerable people, of which approx. 9,000 IDPs and 4,000 disadvantaged youth / 45% women) through improved food sec. and sustainable resource management in the northwest of Central African Republic.
